controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of CY-3211

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on CY-3211 and PT-3211 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CY-3211 and PT-3211 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. CY-3211 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 27 March 2012 a hazard report was recorded on CY-3211 and PT-3211 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
